title: Required Gate Watchdog PR comment 403 despite Issues write
root_cause: Live GitHub Actions run 39811993147 reached POST /issues/4656/comments and returned HTTP 403 Resource not accessible by integration. Effective GITHUB_TOKEN permissions were Issues:write but PullRequests:read; GitHub REST docs claim either write permission suffices, while upstream github/rest-api-description#6994 documents that some installations require Pull requests:write as well. A permissions mismatch is observed; remediation efficacy awaits live replay.
impact: Existing watchdog aborted after one failed PR comment, despite successfully dispatching one missing Required test, preventing later PRs in that execution from receiving recovery handling.
failed_approaches: Treat Issues:write as guaranteed sufficient for PR conversation comment creation
Classify a failed owner-signal dispatch as delivered
Bypass browser CLS <=0.100 or Required/CodeQL checks to make the job green
fix: Grant pull-requests:write in the existing five-minute required-gate-watchdog.yml while preserving issues:write, actions:write and contents:read. Assert the effective PR write scope in the regression test.
prevention_rule: Every agent writing PR conversation comments must have PR write scope and must verify actual provider-side write/readback; permissions declared in YAML alone are not sufficient evidence. Failed handoffs remain BLOCKED until provider confirmation, not silently green.
outcome: CANDIDATE: source and regression test; no claim that the PR comment delivery works until exact live verification.

negative_canary: Do not weaken Required/CodeQL or CLS threshold
No duplicate comments for same head/gate
No unrelated PR write outside existing owner signal
invariants: Historical/shadow/canary run the same actual Node regression contract; proof of a provider comment still requires a post-merge live readback
Keep Required CI, CodeQL, CLS threshold and owner-dedup protection
